item.title: Kori Shingles named senior community engagement manager at PCL Construction
item.description: Kori Shingles has been named Senior Community Engagement Manager at PCL Construction.

item.title: As USMCA review looms, auto industry faces uncertain future
item.description: Trade experts warn the July USMCA review could reshape the North American auto industry as Trump questions the pact’s future.

item.title: Trump nuclear push revives search for radioactive waste storage
item.description: The Trump administration’s nuclear expansion plan ties new reactors to finding states willing to host permanent radioactive waste sites.

item.title: Wisconsin approves $207M in state and university construction projects
item.description: Wisconsin’s State Building Commission approved $207 million for construction and repairs at state facilities and UW campuses statewide.

item.title: AI reshaping HR decisions on pay, promotions and layoffs
item.description: AI agents are increasingly used in HR for payroll, reviews and layoffs, raising concerns about transparency, bias and the need for human oversight.

item.title: Just Sold: Buhl pays $3.8M for industrial building
item.description: An entity related to St. Louis Park-based Buhl Investors has paid $3.8 million for a multitenant light industrial building in Spring Lake Park.

item.title: Milwaukee weighs $6.7M in TIF for stalled housing projects
item.description: Milwaukee proposes $6.7 million in tax incremental financing to support two workforce housing projects in Walker’s Point.

item.title: Q&A: Alex Baron on new company Stack Industrial Partners
item.description: Four former Transwestern brokers have launched Stack Industrial Partners, a new Edina-based firm focused exclusively on industrial real estate.

item.title: 96-unit apartment project revived in Monticello
item.description: Brick by Brick Development plans a 96-unit market-rate apartment building in Monticello, adding new housing near Walmart after planning commission approval.

item.title: Interview: Tina Wyffels, president, BKBM Engineers
item.description: Tina Wyffels, the new president of BKBM Engineers talks about her new duties as president, the company’s projected workload in 2026, the struggle to attract workers in the industry, and the importance of “pivoting and adapting” to ensure the firm’s success.
